reviews.comment:
pedimos dos sandwich de milanesas en Full, según la foto venia con lechuga y tomate (1800$ c/u) nos la  entregan envueltas, nos sentamos (mesas sucias llenas de moscas) abrimos el envoltorio y estaban secas sin la ensalada, reclamo y me dicen (de mala onda) que tenia que haberla pedido con ensalada y me muestran un mini cartel en un costado que dice que hay que pedirla, si esta en la foto la tienen que entregar con ensalada, el que no la quiere que la saque o que pregunten, no se entiende, me la dieron de remala gana y siempre repitiendo que la tenia que haber pedido.

(Translated by Google)
We ordered two breaded cutlet sandwiches at Full. According to the photo, they came with lettuce and tomato ($1800 each). They were delivered wrapped, we sat down (dirty tables full of flies), we opened the wrapping and they were dry without the salad. I complained and they told me (in a bad mood) that I should have ordered it with salad and showed me a small sign on the side that said that you have to ask for it, if it's in the photo they have to deliver it with salad, if you don't want it take it out or ask. It doesn't make sense, they gave it to me very reluctantly and kept repeating that I should have ordered it.
